overall.verdict: A coherent, genuinely premium dark wallet whose honest money-location model (on-chain/reserve/collateral vs trust) is a real differentiator, undermined by exposed protocol jargon (frames, lanes, lazy entity, entity id), decimal noise, and an unexplained one-scale bar system that reads as decoration. Core flows (pay, receipt, account risk) are strong; move/lend/receive-collateral flows leak mechanics and dead-end states.
priority_fixes: Kill decimal noise and jargon globally: cap at 2–4 decimals, rename frames/lanes/entity id/lazy into plain language, truncate all hex addresses behind copy chips
Make the one-scale bar system self-explanatory: label endpoints, print '1 px = $10', and legend-match every segment color; collapse zero-value legend rows
Fix dead-end and contradictory states (10-move cap 0.00 vs 190.00, 12-assets 'Collateral unavailable' with no next step, disabled buttons without guidance)
Replace 'frame #N' and raw latency ('in 60832 ms') in consumer surfaces with time-ago and friendly settlement copy; keep raw ids in detail views
Promote trust actions (Save evidence bundle, proof verify/copy) to visible primary affordances, and separate destructive vault actions in Settings
